Supplementary Examination
(CBCS)(SUBJECTIVE TYPE)(OffLine)
Course Name:< B.Tech.(CSE-Al)>, Semester:<VIII>
(May, 2025)
Subject Code: HMC 402 Subject: Creativity Innovation and Entrepreneurship
Time :3 Hours Maximum Marks :60
Note:Q. 1 is compulsory. Attempt one question each from the Units I, Il, Ill & IV.
rT) a) Define the term innovation. What are the major categories of innovation typically seen
in the tech industry?
b) Mention a modern technique used to boost creativity in Al-based projects. How does
this differ from traditional problem-solving approaches?
c) Briefly describe a structured framework used for creative problem-solving in Al
applications.
d) Name two key ethical principles in Al development. How do they contribute to reducing
bias and promoting transparency?
e) Howcan Al innovation be protected theory patents and copyrights?
f) What is the role of Al for social good initiatives?
g) Describe the Lean Startup methodology. How is it particularly useful for Al-focused
entrepreneurs?
h) Why is market validation essential during the early phases of an Al startup?
UNIT-I
Describe three practical methods for enhancing creativity within Al projects.
Illustrate each method with an example from real-world Al development.
How does brainstorming contribute to ideation in Al-based business ventures?
Suggest three techniques to conduct effective brainstorming sessions aimed at
generating innovative Al startup ideas.
UNIT-II
Whatis the core ethical principles guiding responsible Al development? Discuss how
they help reduce bias and support fairness, including examples from real Al projects.
What is Al bias, and why is it a major concern in automated decision-making?
Present two methods to address and reduce algorithmic bias and assess their
effectiveness.
UNIT-III
Explain how the innovation process in Al differs from traditional innovation | (10)
approaches. Discuss the role of Licensing & IPR.
Discuss the role of responsible Al development and deployment. (10)
UNIT-IV
Highlight the essential components of entrepreneurship in the Al sector. In what
ways does identifying opportunities in Al differ from traditional markets?
Examine the unique challenges faced by Al startups during development and scaling.
Propose actionable strategies to manage these obstacles and ensure sustainable
growth.
